title: Career Roadmap · Textile Supervisor
summary: A Textile Supervisor oversees textile production teams, machines, quality, workflow and production targets across weaving, spinning, processing or garment manufacturing units.

blocks.label: Recommended
blocks.text: Complete Class 10 for eligible ITI trades; Class 12 can broaden diploma and degree options.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Science with Mathematics can help for technical diploma and degree pathways, but is not universally required for vocational entry.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Textile fibres, yarn, weaving, garment production, machinery, quality control and workplace safety.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Basic mathematics, observation, communication, teamwork and problem-solving.

rows.text: Advanced manufacturing, process engineering and production leadership

blocks.text: ITI and diploma entry rules vary by trade and state. Degree admissions may use state or national entrance routes. Verify current official notification before applying.

blocks.text: Industry experience, improvement projects, reporting skills and preparation for supervisory roles or further study.
